statement_nl: If A_{d,r,n,k}(q):=[3dk+r]_q (q^r,q^r,q^d;q^{2d})_k (q^d;q^d)_k q^{k(d-dk-2r)/2}/(-q^d;q^d)_k, then the original theorem sum T_{d,r,n}(q):=∑_{k=0}^{n-1} [3dk+r]_q (q^r,q^r,q^d;q^{2d})_k (q^d;q^d)_k^2 q^{k(d-dk-2r)/2}/(q^{2d};q^{2d})_k satisfies T_{d,r,n}(q)=∑_{k=0}^{n-1} A_{d,r,n,k}(q) in Q(q).
